test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **'idyllic'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the context provided, the passage describes the location of** Kala Bhavan,** an art school founded by Rabindranath Tagore. It mentions that Kala Bhavan was located in a village some distance from Calcutta.
 
• The word "**idyllic**" accurately captures **the sense of a peaceful, picturesque, and harmonious rural setting,** which aligns with the idea of a village being an ideal or perfect location for the school.
 
• Meanings of the other options:
 
 
• **normal** - This word does not convey the sense of a particularly peaceful or picturesque setting.
 
• **magical** - While a village setting may be charming, "**magical**" suggests an element of fantasy or enchantment that may not be appropriate in this context.
 
• **reliable** - This word does not convey the sense of a peaceful or picturesque setting. It refers to something or someone that can be trusted or depended on. 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is "**idyllic**," as it best **describes the serene and picturesque nature of the village where Kala Bhavan was located.**

 

Correct Passage:__ *Rabindranath Tagore founded a small school at Santiniketan in 1901 and Kala Bhavan, an art school, in 1919 which later became a part of the Visvabharati University founded in 1921. Located in an **idyllic** village some distance from the city of Calcutta, Kala Bhavan presented an alternative methodology of art training, in which studio based practice was (3)________ in favour of learning through observation and living as a part of nature. The natural surroundings with the (4)________ of bare red earth dotted with trees, the colours of the changing seasons, the animals and birds (5)________ inspiration to students.*
